title.zh: Anchorage Positions Itself as Custody Backbone of US-Mexico Stablecoin Corridor
title.en: Anchorage Positions Itself as Custody Backbone of US-Mexico Stablecoin Corridor

current_state.zh: Anchorage Digital expanded its custody-and-listing arrangement with Bitso to support stablecoin flows across the US-Mexico remittance corridor, including multi-chain custody of MXNB and listings of Western Union and Tether dollar stablecoins.
current_state.en: Anchorage Digital expanded its custody-and-listing arrangement with Bitso to support stablecoin flows across the US-Mexico remittance corridor, including multi-chain custody of MXNB and listings of Western Union and Tether dollar stablecoins.
